subject: Request: supplementary penetration-test delta report and proposed live re-test window
messages:
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: lucia@ironforge-sec.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: supplementary penetration-test delta report and proposed live re-test window

Hi Lucia,

Thanks again for the initial findings summary. Halcyon wants a short, scoped delta document that isolates the changes we validated after remediation, plus a brief verification letter we can share with their procurement/security team. Specifically they'd like:

- A delta report showing which originally-identified issues were re-tested and the verification results (pass/fail/partial), with CVE/issue IDs mapped to our ticket numbers.
- A short verification letter on IronForge letterhead stating the date(s) of re-test, scope, and overall conclusion.
- A proposed 60–90 minute live re-test window next week so Halcyon can observe any live verification steps (if needed).

Can you confirm availability next week (Mon/Tue preferred) and whether you can provide the delta PDF + letter? Also please include a one-page bulleted timeline of the re-test steps so I can route to Halcyon's compliance lead.

For context: Halcyon Systems is finalizing procurement and needs the delta report for SOC-2 evidence and their third-party risk review. I’ve cc'd Mina (security) and Vivek (customer success).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachments referenced: halcyon_retest_scope_v2.pdf (scope doc)
From: lucia@ironforge-sec.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, tanvi@halcyon.com
Cc: joel@halcyon.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: supplementary penetration-test delta report and proposed live re-test window

Hi Aditya / Tanvi,

We can produce a focused delta report and the verification letter. Quick clarifications before we finalize:

1) Scope baseline: are we validating only the 7 items in the remediation tracker marked "ready for re-test" (see halcyon_retest_scope_v2.pdf), or do you want us to spot-check adjacent controls? Our default is to validate the items marked ready; spot checks add ~2–3 hours.
2) Evidence types: we will include exploit attempts, remediation verification steps, timestamps, and short remediation notes. If Halcyon needs reproducible PoCs included we can redact payloads and provide hashes instead.
3) Live re-test: we have availability for a live window on
   - Mon 2027-04-19 15:00–16:30 UTC
   - Tue 2027-04-20 14:00–15:30 UTC

I attached a short delta summary to expedite review (pen-test-delta-report-20270418.pdf). The formal PDF and letter will be delivered after the live window if you prefer observation; otherwise we can finalize them now based on our internal validation run.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm whether you want the live observation and which window works.
- We finalize whether PoCs should be provided or hashed.

Lucia Moreno
Principal Consultant | IronForge Security
lucia@ironforge-sec.com
+1 202 555 0123

Attachments: pen-test-delta-report-20270418.pdf (preliminary delta summary)
From: mina.haddad@redwood.com
To: lucia@ironforge-sec.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, tanvi@halcyon.com
Date: 2027-04-18T12:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: supplementary penetration-test delta report and proposed live re-test window

Thanks Lucia — this looks good. Halcyon’s procurement specifically called out the need to show SOC 2 evidence mapping for the re-tested items (a short mapping table: Issue -> Control ID -> Result). Can you include that mapping in the delta PDF? It doesn't need to be long, one line per finding is fine.

Aditya — we prefer the Tue 14:00–15:30 UTC window so our internal SMEs can attend. Also, for the PoC question: redact payloads and include hashes — Halcyon is fine with that approach.

Mina Haddad
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Onward: please confirm attendee list for the live session and whether IronForge needs any special access or temporary accounts to perform the checks.
From: lucia@ironforge-sec.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: tanvi@halcyon.com, joel@halcyon.com
Date: 2027-04-18T15:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: supplementary penetration-test delta report and proposed live re-test window

Confirmed for Tue 2027-04-20 14:00–15:30 UTC.

We will:
- Run the formal verification during that window and deliver the final delta PDF plus a concise verification letter within 24 hours of completion.
- Include an appendixed mapping (Issue ID -> Redwood ticket # -> SOC2 CC mapping -> Result).
- Provide PoC hashes instead of full payloads.

Attached final deliverables will be:
- pen-test-delta-report-20270418.pdf (finalized after live run)
- redwood_verification_letter_20270418.pdf (one-page letter for Halcyon procurement)
- halcyon_retest_scope_v2.pdf (scope confirmation)

Access: we will need a single dedicated user account with admin-level API keys disabled; read-only service account + short-lived test account is ideal. Please share the access instructions via the secure Drive folder or the ticket (JIRA-SEC-713).

Lucia Moreno
Principal Consultant | IronForge Security

Attachments (to follow): pen-test-delta-report-20270418.pdf, redwood_verification_letter_20270418.pdf
